MANISHA YADAV Mumbai, Maharashtra | +91- 9870575955 | Email: mishayadav090@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Finance Operations Professional with 4 years of experience in hedge fund and money market operations, specializing in trade processing, NAV support (pre- and post-trade), payment operations (SWIFT), cash reconciliation, and FX processing. Skilled in trade settlement client service, and handling high-volume transactions, resolving operational exceptions, ensuring regulatory compliance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver accurate and timely results.

WORK EXPERIENCE

State Street — Transaction Services Associate-II, Transfer Agency Vertical: Hedge Fund & Mutual Fund April 2022 – April 2026 • Managed Money Market operations and ensured timely and accurate settlement of client fund transactions. • Processed subscriptions, redemptions, switches, and transfers for Hedge Fund and Mutual Fund clients. • Monitored and validated SWIFT MT535 and MT536 messages to support reconciliation and settlement activities. • Processed daily FX rate updates by validating client files and uploading rates to investor accounts. • Performed cash reconciliation and resolved transaction exceptions within SLA timelines. • Handled payment operations, including validation, processing, and settlement of domestic and international

payments.

Investigated payment breaks using SWIFT message tracking and coordinated with internal teams for timely resolution.

Managed high-volume transactions while maintaining accuracy, quality, and operational efficiency. • Collaborated with global teams across Ireland and Luxembourg to resolve client queries and operational issues. • Ensured compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and operational guidelines.

SKILLS

Trade Processing (as per cut-off ) • Money Market Operations • Settlement & post-cycle processing • FX Processing • Cash Reconciliation • Payment Operations • ETA Monitoring & SWIFT handling • SLA Time Management & Multitasking • Client & Team Coordination

EDUCATION

Mumbai University • Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) SKT College of Arts, Commerce & Science

• Certification • MS-CIT & Tally

AWARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS

Champ of the Month (November 2022) — for outstanding performance. • Bravo Award (July 2023) — for operational excellence, and team contributions. • Titan of the Month (February 2024) — Recognized for exceptional performance & high-quality deliverables.
